name: Delaware
sources: Rate schedule (tax years 2014 and after): Delaware Dept. of Finance, Tax Preference Report, https://financefiles.delaware.gov/Reports/TaxPref/3-PIT-2025.pdf

Standard deduction, additional 65+/blind deduction, personal credits, itemizing rules and SALT cap: 2025 PIT-RES instructions, https://revenuefiles.delaware.gov/2025/PITForms_Instructions/Instructions/PIT-RES_Instructions_2025-01.pdf
Proposed 2026 bracket change (HB 13) failed in committee June 2025: https://open.pluralpolicy.com/de/bills/153/HB13
provisional: Brackets, standard deduction ($3,250 / $6,500), $2,500 additional deduction for 65+ and $110 personal credits are the 2025 figures; they are fixed in statute (not indexed) and no 2026 change was found, but 2026 forms are not yet published.

Property-tax cap uses the 2026 federal SALT cap ($40,400; $20,200 married filing separately), which Delaware applies to its itemized deductions; the federal phase-down above $505,000 of income is not modelled.
The extra $110 personal credit applies from age 60 in Delaware; it is modelled for people 65+ only.
notes: Married couples can often pay less by filing 'combined separate' (each spouse on their own brackets); this estimate assumes a joint return.
Filers 60+ may exclude up to $12,500 each of pension and investment income (interest, dividends, gains); that exclusion is not included.
